q: How do I calculate a museum's carbon footprint per visitor?
title: Museum CO2 per visitor
short: Climate control for collections usually dominates: AC and dehumidifiers running all year at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Add lighting, generator diesel and refrigerant top ups, then divide by visitors. Visitor travel to the museum is Scope 3 and often larger.

ul: Electricity by gallery or HVAC system where metered.

p: Tighter humidity bands use more energy. Agree the band with conservators before setting a reduction target.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
